column1: # The RFC 7529 SKIP corpus: every case checked against libical 3.0.20, with the
# answer it gave. Three tab-separated fields: the DTSTART, the RRULE, and up to
# One oracle rather than two, because only one exists: python-dateutil does not
# parse RSCALE at all, and libical is the only widely used implementation that
# resolves SKIP without a calendar library. libical does it for the Gregorian
# scale with no ICU build, which is exactly the half this crate implements.
